en.title: Minimum Moves on an Ice Cream Flavor Carousel (Box OA)
en.description: Given a circularly arranged array of flavors, the current position startIndex, and the target flavor target, find the minimum number of steps needed to move left or right to the target flavor. If the target flavor appears multiple times, choose the nearest one.
en.input: A single line containing a JSON object with flavors (a non-empty array of strings), startIndex (starting from 0), and target (a flavor name that appears in the array).
en.output: Output the minimum number of left/right moves needed to reach any position holding the target flavor.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution. Note: the explanation of the source example clearly specifies the target as originalart, so the candidate only corrects target=banana in the example to originalart; if the original input kept banana, the correct answer would be 0.
hints: The distances in the two directions around the ring add up to n.
When the target name repeats, take the nearest position.
